environment: Windows host, CPython 3.11 (exact patch version recorded in RESULT.json)
hypothesis: On Windows, the V15 stdin polling loop can process anonymous CRT pipe input and EOF while keeping sample and command callbacks on the owner thread.
treatment: Replace Windows select.select on stdin handles with Win32 handle-type-aware waiting: WaitForSingleObject for console handles and PeekNamedPipe polling for pipes; retain select.select for non-Windows.
decision_gate: PASS_CONSTRUCTION_PORTABILITY iff focused 14-test suite passes on Windows in normal and optimized Python, including delayed commands, owner-thread callback identity, and EOF after pipe writer closure.
